# build a maximal-size *valid* request and time it
import json, subprocess, time, random, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/tmp/work')
from stress import mk_trace
rng=random.Random(2)
K=1
fields=[{"name":"f%d"%i,"type":"FLAG"} for i in range(20)]+[{"name":"n%d"%i,"type":"SIZE","min":0,"max":999999999} for i in range(10)]
atoms=[]
for i in range(20):
    atoms.append({"cmp":"eq","left":{"field":"f%d"%i,"at":0},"right":{"const":True,"type":"FLAG"}})
rows=[]
for i in range(4096):
    rows.append({"t":i,"values":[rng.random()<0.8 for _ in range(20)]+[rng.randint(0,999999999) for _ in range(10)]})
train=[mk_trace("tr%d"%s,"s%d"%(s%16),rows[s*256:(s+1)*256]) for s in range(16)]
probes=[mk_trace("pr0","s0",[{"t":i,"values":[rng.random()<0.5 for _ in range(20)]+[rng.randint(0,999999999) for _ in range(10)]} for i in range(128)])]
queries=[mk_trace("q0","s0",[{"t":i,"values":[rng.random()<0.5 for _ in range(20)]+[rng.randint(0,999999999) for _ in range(10)]} for i in range(1024)])]
req={"version":1,"window":K,"schema":fields,"atoms":atoms,"policy":{"max_width":4,"min_support":1,"min_witness":1},"train":train,"probes":probes,"queries":queries}
text=json.dumps(req)
# pad with whitespace inside the root object to approach 8MB
pad = 8388608 - len(text) - 20
text = '{' + ' '*max(0,pad) + text[1:]
print('bytes', len(text))
t0=time.time()
p=subprocess.run(['/app/submission/run.sh'],input=text.encode(),capture_output=True,cwd='/app/submission')
el=time.time()-t0
print('rc',p.returncode,'wall %.2f'%el,'stdout',len(p.stdout))
r=json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
print('classes',len(r['classes']),'members',sum(c['members'] for c in r['classes']),'queries',len(r['queries']))
print(p.stderr.decode()[:200])
EOF
